llm.summary: This skill is a local note-taking and review helper that discloses its file writes and requires user confirmation before changing stored learning records.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture lessons, errors, best practices, reviews, and improvement suggestions; the documented capabilities fit that purpose and are limited to local markdown records.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some trigger phrases are broad conversational Chinese phrases, but the skill repeatedly requires showing proposed content and getting confirmation before writes, and destructive clearing requires double confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown documentation and a license only, with no executable scripts, package install steps beyond the OpenClaw skill install command, hooks, or declared binary requirements.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables or required binaries and describes no network upload, cross-session access, or external service use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It persists sanitized learning summaries under the current project's .learnings directory and can read or clear those records when asked; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want the agent to keep local project learning notes. Review proposed entries before confirming, because they may summarize conversation context, and avoid confirming records that contain sensitive details even though the skill says it will mask secrets.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The README trigger concern is supported in that the phrases are broad, but the behavior is disclosed and state-changing actions require confirmation, so this does not rise to Review by itself.
[SQP-1] expected: The SKILL.md trigger concern is supported in that common phrases can invoke the workflow, but the artifact limits persistence to .learnings, requires confirmation before writes, and requires double confirmation for clearing records.
